subject.title: [Feature]: macOS onboarding freezes on gateway-driven progress steps

question: Should this protected onboarding regression be sponsored as a focused macOS follow-up now, with a live macOS progress-and-completion proof required before landing?
rationale: The code direction appears narrow, but the affected setup flow is protected by the repository's `maintainer` label and requires a Mac build plus live application verification that the report explicitly says has not yet been performed.

options.title: Sponsor focused macOS follow-up
options.body: Mirror the existing web continuation behavior, add the macOS regression test, and require a redacted live download or pull run through completion.

options.title: Defer pending macOS reproduction
options.body: Keep the issue open until an owner can reproduce the freeze and capture the exact macOS session behavior on current main.

recommendation.title: Sponsor focused macOS follow-up
recommendation.body: Mirror the existing web continuation behavior, add the macOS regression test, and require a redacted live download or pull run through completion.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the recent merged work that created both the Gateway progress transport and the macOS onboarding entry point.
